scope: Six sequential implementation and review passes. Evidence is retained externally to the app interface. Fixtures remain synthetic in tests and are never installed as user data.

changes: Removed the visible version/footer and test notice. Real error/status notices remain available only when nonempty.
Removed explicit glass buttons and automatic toolbar glass backing while retaining AppKit controls.
checks: node syntax and web model tests
No .glass or NSGlassEffectView in app UI source; no visible version in HTML.

changes: Added daily practice seconds and weekly practice days from existing completed sessions, with persisted bounded preferences.
Replaced horseshoe dials with concentric circles, quantized arc updates and a matte surface hierarchy.
Kept the primary goal row compact; additional practice goals use two small rails.
checks: Web models cover practice duration, distinct practice days and completion.
State tests cover preference bounds, rounding and persistence.

changes: Separated the last minute histogram from its recorded-time strip, using fixed count scale and explicit overflow.
Added an exposure-weighted weekly summary; missing time is not represented as zero blink rate.
Weekly chart scale advances in fixed five-unit steps rather than moving on every sample.
checks: Model tests distinguish zero rate from unavailable rate, reject unobserved counts and verify weighted aggregation against unequal session lengths.

rounds.focus: Practice and camera setup state review
changes: Setup presents the first unmet condition and hides repeated success descriptions. Stable checklist rows are retained between live updates.
Practice completion distinguishes a captured blink from a timer completion without camera data.
Focus moves to the new setup/practice heading and returns to the initiating practice after completion.
checks: Setup model tests verify ready and camera permission guidance.
Full GUI phase, mirror, setup and focus checks are scheduled in the next round.

changes: Kept 28 pixel minimum control heights and 24 pixel minimum widths, including native web sliders.
Added a one column enlarged layout while preserving vertical scrolling and focus margins.
Reviewed visible text contrast, reduced motion, setup and practice focus, chart descriptions and missing data states in both themes.
checks: Native dashboard tests exercise all five views at normal and double page zoom.
Contrast sampling applies to visible text; hidden duplicate web Pause is excluded because AppKit owns that control.

rounds.focus: Bounded performance review and regression budgets
changes: Added a reproducible Rust matrix at 4, 8, 16 and 32 landmarks per eye, seven web model workloads and native statistics snapshots.
Recorded raw measurements and explicit scope, with review budgets of 5 microseconds per core update, 1 millisecond per statistics snapshot and 16 milliseconds per model operation at p95.
Retained camera model, cadence, calibration and thresholds. Current local costs do not justify another geometry rewrite or a date cache. Setup row reuse avoids repeated DOM replacement.
checks: Scripts/benchmark.sh completes with output assertions and no user data.
Scripts/test.sh passes Rust, web, state, lifecycle, persistence, ABI and Vision checks.

limits: This is an implementation and measured review sequence, not a recursive learning system or WCAG certification.
Manual VoiceOver, physical lifecycle and prolonged camera performance remain separate acceptance checks.
Explicit glass materials and toolbar glass wrappers are disabled. macOS may still style its native menu and system chrome.

review.dashboard: Passed all five views, both themes, minimum layout and double zoom, mirror, setup, coverage and state transitions.
review.overlay: Passed geometry, fade reversal, immediate hiding and display rebuild.
review.signedBundle: Pre-minimize controls and recovery pass. Existing native minimize assertion fails on this desktop.
review.visual: Inspected current-process composited light and dark windows, enlarged layout and circular goals. Fixed timeline scaling, popup hit area and duplicate reset summary during review.
review.provenance: All published screenshots are synthetic test fixtures. The installed app has no fixture seeding or QA labels; personal history was preserved.
